name: Corporación Moctezuma, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Corporación Moctezuma, S.A.B. de C.V., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, distribution, and sale of Portland cement, mortar, white cement, ready-mixed concrete, and aggregates in Mexico. The company offers composite Portland cement, Portland composite cement, and masonry cement. It also provides structural, conventional, exposed, colored, high strength, ultra-accelerated structural, antibacterial, permeable, self-compacting, self-sealing, self-healing, long life, air intake, lightweight, heavy, flowable fill, marine, and durable concrete; MR with fiber; concrete mortar; and shotcrete.
